decisions.reason: The product still has unresolved market uncertainty and likely low ongoing costs, so the option value of keeping it open outweighs the benefit of dropping it.
As a recently launched complement to the firm's messaging services, its prospects remain uncertain and it costs little to keep, making it valuable as an open option.
Because it supports the same secure messaging workflows and is low-cost to maintain, the firm should keep this option open while uncertainty about demand resolves.
